body: Review-integrity rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 16:20Z; P1 w-9d4b9b00c603). A delegation's COMPACT result packet can show "Findings: None" while the child's full output lists real High/Medium findings: an Engram explorer, delegation ea4ec2c6, had 1 High and 4 Medium. RULE for every /review-code pair child and explorer: judge the result ONLY from the FULL paged output (termal_get_session_result, paging until complete:true). Never call a review clean from the compact packet's "None". Every coordinator check of a pair result asks the worker: "verified from full output?". Retire this rule when w-9d4b lands and is running.
